description: Divides an XY plane into four quadrants and passes through the group of signals belonging to the quadrant the coordinate falls in, handing back that coordinate stretched to fill the quadrant

params.text: Sets the range the X and Y outputs take while the coordinate is in quadrant A, the red one: 0V to 10V, or -5V to 5V
Sets the range the X and Y outputs take while the coordinate is in quadrant B, the blue one: 0V to 10V, or -5V to 5V
Sets the range the X and Y outputs take while the coordinate is in quadrant C, the green one: 0V to 10V, or -5V to 5V
Sets the range the X and Y outputs take while the coordinate is in quadrant D, the yellow one: 0V to 10V, or -5V to 5V
Reads the X and Y inputs as -5V to 5V rather than 0V to 10V, which moves the dividing line between quadrants from 5V to 0V

inputs.text: Passes to the first output while the coordinate is in quadrant A, the red one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the second output while the coordinate is in quadrant A, the red one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the third output while the coordinate is in quadrant A, the red one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the fourth output while the coordinate is in quadrant A, the red one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the first output while the coordinate is in quadrant B, the blue one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the second output while the coordinate is in quadrant B, the blue one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the third output while the coordinate is in quadrant B, the blue one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the fourth output while the coordinate is in quadrant B, the blue one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the lower half
Passes to the first output while the coordinate is in quadrant C, the green one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the second output while the coordinate is in quadrant C, the green one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the third output while the coordinate is in quadrant C, the green one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the fourth output while the coordinate is in quadrant C, the green one, where the X reading is in the lower half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the first output while the coordinate is in quadrant D, the yellow one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the second output while the coordinate is in quadrant D, the yellow one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the third output while the coordinate is in quadrant D, the yellow one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Passes to the fourth output while the coordinate is in quadrant D, the yellow one, where the X reading is in the upper half and the Y reading is in the upper half
Sets the X part of the coordinate, 0V to 10V across the plane, or -5V to 5V with the input polarity button pressed; every channel here is a separate coordinate
Sets the Y part of the coordinate, 0V to 10V down the plane, or -5V to 5V with the input polarity button pressed; every channel here is a separate coordinate

outputs.text: Carries the first jack of whichever quadrant group the coordinate has landed in, channel for channel
Carries the second jack of whichever quadrant group the coordinate has landed in, channel for channel
Carries the third jack of whichever quadrant group the coordinate has landed in, channel for channel
Carries the fourth jack of whichever quadrant group the coordinate has landed in, channel for channel
The X part of the coordinate measured inside its own quadrant, stretched so that half the input range fills the whole output range
The Y part of the coordinate measured inside its own quadrant, stretched so that half the input range fills the whole output range
A four-channel gate carrying 10V on the channel of the quadrant the coordinate is in and 0V on the other three, following the first channel of the X and Y inputs alone

notes: nothing is routed until both the X and Y jacks are patched; the smaller of their channel counts sets how many coordinates are read, each picking its own quadrant on its own channel
the four lamps mark which quadrant the first channel has landed in: red for A, blue for B, green for C and yellow for D

inputs.16:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
